notes: Direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Westside (Tata/Trent apparel retailer) has no dedicated Pet Care line. Checked: (1) sitemap_collections_1.xml (all site collections, 8621 lines) grepped for pet|dog|cat|animal|paw -> only one hit, /collections/pet-products-and-accessories ('animal'/'dog'/'cat' hits were all unrelated apparel prints e.g. 'women-animal-print-dresses'). (2) Cross-checked via storefront /collections.json across 4 pages (1000 collections total) -> same single match, handle 'pet-products-and-accessories', title 'Pet Accessories & Essentials'. (3) Fetched that collection's /products.json (14 products, page 2 empty -> confirmed complete) and its rendered HTML JSON-LD ItemList (same 14 items) -> every single product is a bath/hand/face towel or a laundry organiser (e.g. 'Westside Home Dark Blue Self-Striped Hand Towel', 'Westside Home Brown Organiser'); zero pet beds/bowls/toys/leashes/litter/carriers despite the collection's og:title metadata claiming 'Accessories, Beds, Bowls & Toys' (a generic/templated SEO title that does not reflect the actual curated products - one product's tag list shows 'Pet Story' as an internal print/motif tag, not a literal pet-product tag). This collection is a false positive and was excluded per the pet-themed-vs-pet-care and generic-product-type rules (towels/organisers with no pet-specific parent branch are not Pet Care). (4) Site search (/search?q=...) was tested and found unreliable: 'zzxxqqnonsense123' returned 0 results but 'pet bed' returned 228 results with no visible matching product titles in the static HTML (results are rendered client-side via a Wizzy search widget) - consistent with the known false-absence/false-presence risk of this site's search, so it was not used as evidence either way; the sitemap+collections.json full enumeration was used instead as the authoritative check. No Pets/Dogs/Cats entry exists in the main nav or footer either. Conclusion: Westside Home carries no genuine Pet Care category (feeding, grooming, hygiene, toys, walking, housing, clothing, travel, or training) anywhere on the site. Zero rows emitted.
